name: builder-interview-harness
description: Run one work-sample interview against a person, a bot, or a team and draft an evidence-backed scorecard. Decision support only.
author: CornerStone AI Research Lab

scripts.demo:bot: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js bot
scripts.demo:team: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js team
scripts.interview: npm run build --silent && node dist/src/cli.js human
